review.final_result: second Codex review found no major issues

observed_compatibility_changes: A typed target with an Any operand now runs its run-time class's in-place dunder before the binary fallback; the selected P.__ipow__ and subclass R.__iadd__ cases change from a wrong new object to CPython's in-place result.
Unsupported dynamic arithmetic names all twelve in-place operators with OP=, names binary exponentiation as ** or pow(), and preserves sequence-specific error paths.
Dynamic *= with a dict or program-class object on the left now follows CPython's in-place number protocol and reports *= instead of incorrectly taking the binary sequence-repeat error path.
The 64 retained dynamic-Any, scalar-union and tomllib programs have unchanged hosted IR.
related_open_gaps: Issue #798 remains the original tracker for this merged correction.
Issue #810 tracks the remaining dynamic dict | and |= case.
Issue #797 tracks the remaining dynamic is/id() mismatches found by the fuzzer.
No new uncovered correctness bug was confirmed, so no issue was filed.
setup_corrections: The first reference comparison omitted the checked-in [exit N] marker and therefore falsely classified 0/66 recordings as matching; the corrected replay appended the exit marker and passed 66/66.

The first IR comparison used checkout roots of unequal length, so five tomllib outputs appeared different only in embedded path-string length constants; recompiling the previous source from an equal-length root made all 5/5 tomllib outputs byte-identical.
